palette.primary_role: Near-black text and white canvas. All three brands use a warm or teal-tinted near-black for text — never pure #000000. OpenAI uses #0d0d0d (teal undertone), Claude uses #141413 (olive undertone), Mistral uses #1f1f1f. White predominates as the primary background.
palette.accent_role: Singular brand accent used extremely sparingly. OpenAI teal (#10a37f) — the lone color in a neutral system. Claude terracotta (#c96442) — earthy, deliberately un-tech. Mistral orange (#fa520f) — vivid European confidence. Each represents a different temperature: cool-teal, warm-earth, hot-amber.
palette.surface_role: Light canvases dominate, but each brand tints differently. OpenAI: true white with pearl (#f5f5f5) cards. Claude: parchment (#f5f4ed) evokes premium paper. Mistral: warm ivory (#fffaeb) radiates golden warmth. The surface color IS the brand temperature.
palette.neutral_role: Secondary text and metadata. All three use warm or neutral grays — Claude's are exclusively warm-toned (olive-gray), OpenAI's are neutral, Mistral's lean warm. No cool blue-grays in any brand.
palette.border_role: Hairline borders used sparingly. Claude uses warm cream borders. OpenAI uses neutral #e5e5e5. Mistral uses minimal borders — separation through background color instead.

border_radius.sharp: 0px - 4px (Mistral uses near-zero radius — sharp, architectural geometry)
border_radius.typical_button: 8px (Claude warm sand) to 12px (OpenAI rectangular CTAs), 9999px for chips

button_styles.border_radius: 8px - 12px (soft rectangular, never pill for primary CTAs)
button_styles.text: Try ChatGPT, Start building, Get started, Sign in
Learn more, Read docs, View research

elevation.shadows: whisper-soft to warm golden — AI brands avoid heavy shadows
elevation.approach: OpenAI uses hover shadows only (0 4px 16px rgba(13,13,13,0.06)). Claude uses ring shadows (0px 0px 0px 1px warm gray) instead of drop shadows. Mistral uses dramatic 5-layer warm golden shadows (amber-tinted rgba) for a unique golden-hour effect.

typical_order: header (sticky, clean, logo left, nav links center/right, minimal CTAs)
hero (editorial layout — serif or large sans headline + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary link, often with subtle illustration or product screenshot)
model_showcase (card grid comparing models/tiers — names, capabilities, badges, 'Try' links)
features (2-3 column cards, editorial descriptions, soft borders, product UI screenshots)
dark_section (alternating — dark bg with white text, product demo, warm or cool depending on brand)
capabilities (icon + title + description grid, research-paper-like presentation)
testimonials (quote cards, developer/user quotes, company logos)
blog_highlights (recent research, announcements, essays — editorial card grid)
cta (centered, warm or neutral bg, brand accent CTA)
footer (clean multi-column: product, research, company, legal + copyright)
hero_variants: editorial_serif (OpenAI — Signifier serif 56px, weight 400, -0.02em tracking, teal accent, clean white bg)
literary_warm (Claude — Anthropic Serif 64px, weight 500, line-height 1.10, parchment bg, terracotta CTA)
billboard_warm (Mistral — 82px Arial weight 400, -2.05px tracking, line-height 1.00, warm ivory bg, golden ambient)
feature_card_variants: editorial_card (white bg, 1px border #ededed, 16px radius, serif or sans title, relaxed body)
ring_shadow_card (warm surface, 0px 0px 0px 1px ring shadow instead of border — Claude signature)
golden_shadow_card (warm cream surface, 5-layer amber-tinted shadow cascade — Mistral signature)
model_comparison_card (bordered card, name + description + capability badges, clean grid)

tone_profile.headline_style: essay-like, declarative but unhurried, 4-8 words (e.g., 'Creating safe AGI that benefits all of humanity', 'Frontier AI for everyone', 'Model performance at the frontier')
tone_profile.cta_style: invitations, not demands (Try, Explore, Start building, Read research, Sign in — never 'Buy now' or 'Limited time')
anti_patterns: bright saturated colors in large surfaces

color_mood: teal_neutral (OpenAI: #ffffff canvas, #0d0d0d ink, #10a37f lone accent, mist/pearl surfaces — clinical restraint)
warm_terracotta (Claude: #f5f4ed parchment, #141413 warm black, #c96442 earthy accent, warm cream borders — literary warmth)
golden_amber (Mistral: #fffaeb warm ivory, #1f1f1f dark, #fa520f vivid orange, amber shadow cascade — European confidence)
typography_mood: serif_editorial (OpenAI: Signifier serif for display, Söhne sans for UI — literary announcement tone)
serif_literary (Claude: Anthropic Serif weight 500 for all headlines, Anthropic Sans for body — book-title gravitas)
single_weight_billboard (Mistral: weight 400 everywhere, hierarchy through size 82px->16px, uppercase CTAs — French declaration)
layout_density: generous_editorial (all three: large section spacing 96-128px, 1.60 line-height for body, each section breathes like a magazine spread)
light_dark_alternation (Claude: parchment/ivory sections alternate with near-black, creating chapter-like rhythm)
golden_warmth_throughout (Mistral: no alternation — every surface is warm-toned, from ivory through cream to amber)

pricing_page.best_practices: Per-token or per-seat pricing with clear tiers, model capability comparison table, enterprise/API volume options

docs_page.best_practices: API reference with code blocks in mono font, interactive examples, model capability documentation, rate limits clearly displayed

research_page.best_practices: Academic paper listing with abstract previews, author credits, date badges, PDF/arXiv links, topic categories
